domain-information: A Ranch Owner sets breeding goals and budget plans to ensure sustainable herd growth
A Ranch Owner reviews sales reports and adjusts operations to maximize profitability
A Herd Manager tracks cattle movements and organizes pastures to maintain grazing balance
A Herd Manager records births to keep accurate livestock count
A Veterinarian conducts health checks and administers vaccines to prevent disease outbreaks
A Veterinarian advises the herd manager on treatment plans to maintain herd wellness
A Feeding Coordinator plans ration schedules and orders feed to support optimal growth
A Feeding Coordinator monitors water and nutrient intake to ensure cattle health
A Sales Agent negotiates with buyers and schedules deliveries to maximize revenue
A Sales Agent maintains client records and follows up on past sales to build customer relationships

associations.description: Ranch Owner defines the Breeding Goal
Ranch Owner sets the Budget Plan
Herd Manager aligns work with the Breeding Goal
Herd Manager assigns cattle to the Pasture
Herd Manager records the Cattle Movement
Cattle Movement updates the Pasture location
Herd Manager maintains the Livestock Count
Herd Manager logs each Birth Record
Birth Record increases the Livestock Count
Veterinarian performs the Health Check
Health Check is applied to Cattle
Veterinarian administers the Vaccination
Vaccination is given to Cattle
Veterinarian prepares the Treatment Plan
Treatment Plan guides the Herd Manager
Feeding Coordinator creates the Ration Schedule
Feeding Coordinator monitors the Feed Intake
Cattle generate the Feed Intake
Feeding Coordinator places the Feed Order
Sales Agent arranges the Delivery
Delivery goes to the Buyer
Delivery contributes data to the Sales Report
Sales Agent prepares the Sales Report
Sales Agent maintains the Client Record
Sales Agent informs the Budget Plan
Ranch Owner reviews the Sales Report
